description: This file defines a Java Swing component 'SizeSelectorPanel' that presents a grid-based UI for selecting sizes, with interactive mouse event handling to update selection and notify a listener.

classes.name: SizeSelectorPanel
classes.description: A JPanel that displays a grid of selectable elements representing size options.

classes.name: SizeSelectorPanel.Element
classes.description: An inner class representing individual grid elements that display oval indicators.

methods.name: SizeSelectorPanel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the grid layout, creating elements, and setting up mouse listeners for interaction.

methods.name: Element.getPreferredSize
methods.description: Returns the preferred size of each grid element as 25x25 pixels.

methods.name: Element.paint
methods.description: Draws an oval in the panel, color-coded based on selection state.
